summary.conclusion: openai/gpt-6-luna has zero successful Codex-channel structured-output trials and is NOT certified at any level. Two independent channel barriers were observed (Paseo 0.9.1 draft-2020-12 dialect rejection; Codex response_format oneOf rejection), either of which fails the production assessor turn before model capability is exercised. The S13 OpenCode-channel evidence (opencode-go/gpt-6-luna 4/4) does not transfer across channels. Bounded follow-ups: (1) strict-mode reformulation of the semantic-assessment schema (contract change, requires revalidation, no silent weakening); (2) Paseo draft-2020-12 support or AEH-side dialect handling (out of scope for the model-routing repair); (3) rerun this matrix once (1)+(2) land, then certify on N>=2 schema-valid trials.
